notes: Checked on 2026-11-09 against each paper's method section (research subagent) and the repository's RELATED_WORK.md. Sources: SciMON arXiv 2305.14259; ResearchAgent 2404.07738; SciAgents 2409.05556; SciPIP 2410.23166; ResearchBench (RELATED_WORK.md item 5); concept graph (RELATED_WORK.md item 3); MatKG and ACCELMAT (RELATED_WORK.md items 1 and 9); MOOSE-Chem 2410.07076 and MOOSE-Chem2 2505.19209; IdeaBench 2411.02429; Chain of Ideas 2410.13185; Scideator 2409.14634; AI co-scientist 2502.18864. Not included: HypoGeniC (2404.04326) generates hypotheses from labelled data, not from papers. 'yes' = an offline extraction pass over the corpus before any question; 'corpus' = a fixed corpus without model extraction; 'no' = retrieval per question.
footer: Most systems build or extract a fixed corpus before any question is asked. A few recent agents (Chain of Ideas, Scideator, AI co-scientist) retrieve on demand, as ours does; none of them is evaluated on materials.
